name: Illumina COLO829 tumour-only, 50x, somatic indels (Chen et al. 2025 Supplementary Table 7b)
description: Tumour-only somatic indel calling scored by AUPRC and by precision, recall and F1 at the best-F1 threshold, with TP, FP and FN counts.

attributes.protocol: Each caller is run on the tumour BAM alone; calls are compared with the filtered cell-line truth set using som.py (hap.py 0.3.12) and ClairS-TO compare_vcf, which the authors cross-checked. Precision, recall and F1 are reported at the quality threshold giving the best F1.
limitations: Developer paper: the authors developed ClairS-TO and its SS and SSRS models (author_reported); Clair3, also run here, comes from the same group. Comparators were run by the authors with their recommended settings.

Tumour-only calling of cell lines; the truth sets were derived from tumour-normal data and are filtered to variants with coverage at least 4, at least 3 alternative reads and VAF at least 0.05, so very low-VAF variants are not scored.

Precision, recall and F1 are at the best achievable F1 over the caller's quality threshold, chosen on the test data (Figure 2 legend); AUPRC summarises the whole curve. Neither is an operating point fixed in advance.

name: Relevance of Illumina COLO829, indels tumour-only calling (Chen et al. 2025) to "Select a tumour DNA somatic variant-calling workflow"
description: Proxy, not direct: the endpoint matches (per-caller precision, recall and F1 on held-out cell lines with consortium truth sets), but the callers used tumour reads only, whereas this use case's inputs include a matched normal and its exclusions list tumour-only calling. Linked as the closest evidence for users without a matched normal.

attributes.endpoint: AUPRC, and precision, recall, F1, TP, FP and FN at the best-F1 threshold, for tumour-only somatic indel calling by the callers in Supplementary Table 7b
attributes.rationale: Proxy, not direct: the endpoint matches (per-caller precision, recall and F1 on held-out cell lines with consortium truth sets), but the callers used tumour reads only, whereas this use case's inputs include a matched normal and its exclusions list tumour-only calling. Linked as the closest evidence for users without a matched normal.
constraints: Inspect every linked evaluation's source locator before citing a result.
Do not combine this mapping's evaluations with any other protocol's results; truth sets, specimens, sequencing and caller versions differ between sources.
limitations: Developer paper: the authors developed ClairS-TO and its SS and SSRS models (author_reported); Clair3, also run here, comes from the same group. Comparators were run by the authors with their recommended settings.

Tumour-only calling of cell lines; the truth sets were derived from tumour-normal data and are filtered to variants with coverage at least 4, at least 3 alternative reads and VAF at least 0.05, so very low-VAF variants are not scored.

Precision, recall and F1 are at the best achievable F1 over the caller's quality threshold, chosen on the test data (Figure 2 legend); AUPRC summarises the whole curve. Neither is an operating point fixed in advance.
Clair3 is a germline caller; its calls were treated as somatic after removing those tagged by ClairS-TO's panels of normals.
Single sample per dataset; no interval estimates.
Comparator versions are old relative to the paper (DeepSomatic 1.7.0 run from the 'latest' container; Mutect2 4.2.6.1; Octopus 0.7.4; Pisces 5.3.0).
Competing interests: the senior author (R.L.) receives research funding from ONT.

Short-read comparators (DeepSomatic WGS_TUMOR_ONLY, Mutect2 with gnomAD germline resource, Octopus, Pisces) were run in tumour-only mode; the panel-of-normals and filtering choices for each are in the Supplementary Information command lines.

TP + FN is not identical across callers (SNV 40,232, but 40,230 for Pisces; indel 715, but 714 for Mutect2 and 713 for Octopus), so the scored truth set differs slightly between rows; the source does not explain this.
Whether the DeepSomatic 1.7.0 models were trained with COLO829 data is not stated in the source.
